serialized.description: A vector (1-D Tensor) of type string containing binary serialized `SequenceExample` protos.

context_features.description: A mapping of feature keys to `FixedLenFeature` or `VarLenFeature` or `RaggedFeature` values. These features are associated with a `SequenceExample` as a whole.

sequence_features.description: A mapping of feature keys to `FixedLenSequenceFeature` or `VarLenFeature` or `RaggedFeature` values. These features are associated with data within the `FeatureList` section of the `SequenceExample` proto.

example_names.description: A vector (1-D Tensor) of strings (optional), the name of the serialized protos.

output.description: A tuple of three `dict`s, each mapping keys to `Tensor`s, `SparseTensor`s, and `RaggedTensor`. The first dict contains the context key/values, the second dict contains the feature_list key/values, and the final dict contains the lengths of any dense feature_list features.
